Corollary
[Higher-order compact embeddings] 1. ch7:7.22\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0180 The embeddings \[ W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )\hookrightarrow L^q(\Omega ) \quad \left(kp<n,\ q<\frac{np}{n-kp}\right) \] and \[ W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )\hookrightarrow C^m(\overline\Omega ) \quad \left(0\leq m<k-\frac np\right) \] are compact.
Proof

\sketch Iterate Theorem 7.22 through the derivatives of order below $k$.

□
